decided.D1: share of the log gain C″ → search3 that c2-refit (with its fall-back) obtains, Annex B test split, scored periods, 95% interval
decided.D2: among scored periods where search3's first candidate is not the true history by the edge-aware rule: shares ambiguous, search failure, evidence failure (threshold 3, 120 s)
decided.D3: attainable headroom: geometric mean per-period ratio search3 ÷ ident-search and search3 ÷ ident-all (the reference held where it drifts), each material / not material / inconclusive against 1.10
decided.D4: share of the 400 held-course periods on which a manoeuvre is declared, for search3, C″, search3-flat and search3-mix
decided.D5: recommendation on a learned whole-period model by spec 014's rule, unchanged

changed_definitions: the search is search3 (prior version 3: every open factor's volume is the reciprocal of its density)
a found history is the true one by match.same_history (manoeuvres cut by the period are ignored), in the classing, the candidates and the counts
D2's shares are of scored periods (spec 014: of all periods)
the true-history reference is held to the true times where it fails the match rule (flagged); D3 is also reported without flagged periods
c2-refit falls back to C″'s track when its fit is not acceptable (research R4, as changed on development data); D1 is also reported without fall-back periods

forecasts.D1: 0.50; the interval includes 0.5 and excludes 0.25 and 0.75
forecasts.D2: first candidate right in 0.63 of scored periods; among wrong: ambiguous 0.50, search failure 0.12, evidence failure 0.38
forecasts.D3: ident-search: inconclusive or not material, point 1.05 to 1.08; ident-all: point 1.12 to 1.20, verdict a coin's toss between inconclusive and material
forecasts.D4: search3 0.50 (between 0.44 and 0.56); C″ 0.02; flat prior 0.01; mixed prior 0.01. By length for search3: under 0.15 below 30 minutes, above 0.90 over 60 minutes
forecasts.soundness: pass: reference at 1.0 to 1.15 of the bound on tight rows; every fit consistent; 12% to 18% of references held

recommendation_rule: Spec 014's, unchanged: pursue a learned whole-period model only if the ident-all headroom is material on the Annex B test split. The record states the rule's output and, separately, what the evidence supports and is silent on (FR-013).
soundness_stop: validation seed 336: history-fixed range efficiency on rows bounded below 0.05 within [0.8, 1.3]; at least 0.90 of true-history fits with a consistent cost; at most 0.25 of references held. Otherwise seed 337 is not generated.
changed_after_development: the refit's fall-back keeps a fit whose cost the noise explains (the first form fell back in 26 of 200 periods); untested on any run
